failed.title: The read failed
failed.body: The data could not be read. Nothing was inferred from this failure.

denied.body: This account cannot see this data. Ask its owner for access.
signedOut.title: Sign in to Cortex
signedOut.body: This page reads your account on the Cortex server. Connect and sign in to use it.
error.not_found: This item no longer exists. Refresh to see the current state.
error.conflict: This item changed in the meantime. Refresh and try again.
error.permission_denied: This account is not allowed to do that.
error.invalid_request: The server refused this value. Check it and try again.
error.other: The request did not complete. Nothing was changed.
widgets.title: Library / Widgets
widgets.lead: Cards published by your chat artifacts, gathered on one board.
widgets.notice: Live widgets are not available on this server yet. No usage or sync data is received.
widgets.emptyBody: Widgets appear here when a chat artifact publishes a card.
browser.title: Local browser
browser.lead: Choose what Cortex can read. You can withdraw your permission at any time.
browser.notice: The local Chrome operator needs a browser extension host that this app does not ship yet. No tab, cookie or sign-in is accessed.
browser.emptyBody: Opening this page never starts a connection.
plan.lead: Your work plans, from the first draft to the last check.
plan.emptyBody: A plan turns a long answer into steps you can tick off. Create one, or ask a chat to plan the work.
plan.dialog: A title, and one step per line.
plan.detailLead: Steps structure the work. The status follows their progress.
plan.missingBody: The ID matches no plan on this account. No other plan is shown in its place.
plan.noSteps: This plan is waiting for its first steps
plan.noStepsBody: Add one precise action to begin.
step.placeholder: One precise action to carry out

appr.caption: Confirmation by action type
